description: Create a purchasable product for a Neblla app. type must be "one_time" (single purchase, fixed price) or "consumable" (quantity selector, price per unit). name should be a multi-language object e.g. { en: "Gold Coins", es: "Monedas de Oro" }. price (one_time) and pricePerUnit (consumable) are in cents (e.g. 499 = $4.99).

name.description: Product name, string or { en: "...", es: "..." }

price.description: Price in cents — required for one_time

pricePerUnit.description: Price per unit in cents — required for consumable

name: neblla_create_product
